scenes.stage_direction: Adrian's surviving records reopen grief. Leave a pause around Amara's response; David does not speak over it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The records establish preparation. They do not establish why the person expected to need it.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I know. I just hate how carefully we have to speak while Ethan is still away.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Carefully is how we keep a suspicion from burying the part we can prove.

metadata.evidence_summary: An estate decision was prepared before the death announcement.
